method.members: Registered votes per member in the analysed sessions. Deviating: a cast vote (yes, no, abstain) that differs from the party's position in that roll call, of the cast votes where the party had one. Absence and deviation are not opposition by themselves.
method.leader_debates: Words, speeches and replies per party and debate. Topics: the learned issue lexicon applied to the party's speeches. Keywords: word stems with the highest tf-idf, term frequency per 10,000 words times log(documents / documents with the stem), where a document is one party in one party-leader debate.
method.agenda: Per riksmöte, each issue debate's speeches and replies shared equally across its issue areas, as a share of all.
method.terms: Word stems in the issue debates per 10,000 words, the latest riksmöte against the three before; ratio smoothed by +0.5 per 10,000 words; only stems used at least 40 times.
